# J.G. Petrucci Company and BGO Fully Lease 216,000-SF Bethlehem Cold Storage Facility to Freshpet

August 13, 2026• 3 min read

J.G. Petrucci Company and BGO Cold Chain announced Aug. 11 that Freshpet has signed a lease for the full 216,000 square feet of a cold storage development at 757 Hellertown Road in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, securing a single tenant for the project ahead of its scheduled year-end 2026 completion.

The facility marks Freshpet's first dedicated cold storage building and sits in close proximity to the company's existing Bethlehem Kitchen, as well as near Interstate 78 and other major roadways. The project was developed through a joint venture between J.G. Petrucci Company and BGO Cold Chain, with construction managed by Petrucci's in-house firm, J.G. Petrucci Company.

results.author: Charlotte

PermaCold Logistics Breaks Ground on 120,000-Square-Foot Frozen Cold Storage Facility in Albertville, Alabama

- September 30, 2026

## PermaCold Logistics Breaks Ground on 120,000-Square-Foot Frozen Cold Storage Facility in Albertville, Alabama

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Albertville, Alabama (September 30, 2026) – Albertville is getting colder! PermaCold Logistics has officially broken ground on a new state-of-the-art cold storage facility that will add significant temperature-controlled storage capacity to one of Alabama’s most important food processing and poultry regions.

The 120,000 square-foot facility, expertly designed and constructed by Ti Cold, will feature approximately 17,000 pallet positions and rise approximately 50 feet tall. The facility is being developed to provide modern, high-capacity frozen storage and logistics services to manufacturers, processors and distributors throughout Albertville and the surrounding Southeast market.

# PermaCold breaks ground on 120,000-square-foot cold store in Alabama

The 17,000-pallet-position facility will serve manufacturers, processors and distributors in Albertville and the Southeast.

 October 14, 2026 

PermaCold Logistics has broken ground on a new frozen cold storage facility in Alabama. Designed and constructed by Ti Cold, the 120,000-square-foot (approx. 11,148-m²) facility will provide temperature-controlled storage and logistics services for manufacturers, processors and distributors.

The facility will feature approximately 17,000 pallet positions and rise approximately 50 feet (15.2 m) tall. It is being developed to provide high-capacity frozen storage and logistics services to customers in Albertville and the surrounding Southeast market.

The project is located in a region with poultry and food manufacturing industries. Its design incorporates specialized construction requirements for frozen food storage and distribution operations.
